name: Exam Revision Sprint
description: A dense, fast revision deck: the map of the whole topic, key terms, the rules or formula, the traps examiners set, and two checks. Higher density for older students.
audience: Last-week revision for board and university exams.

signals.why: your words mention revision or exams
exam years benefit from denser slides

slides.guidance: Lesson title for {topic} and a short subtitle that names the class level.
One overview of {topic}: the central idea and how the main parts connect to it.
The terms examiners expect for {topic}, each with a one-line meaning.
The main formula or rule to memorise for {topic}, every symbol defined. Use the key rule if there is no formula.
A mistake students lose marks on in {topic} and the correct statement.
An exam-style question on {topic}: recall plus one step of application.
A harder exam-style question on {topic} that mixes two ideas.
The five things to remember on exam day for {topic}.
